merge_rules.by-id: List section. Overlay omitted: inherit. Overlay []: clear. Non-empty: entries merge by id; an overlay entry with a known id is merged field by field over the default entry (nested objects deep-merge, scalars and plain lists are replaced, the project wins); a new id is appended. Entries can be removed through disabled.
merge_rules.add-only: List section that holds hard rules. Overlay omitted: inherit. The overlay may append entries with new ids; it may not clear the section, replace an existing id, or disable an entry (hard rules outrank everything below them). Matching route_floor hard rules combine by max (strictest wins); an appended rule may not be weaker than a default rule whose `when` it overlaps.
merge_rules.deep: Map section. Overlay omitted: inherit. Overlay object: deep-merged over the default (the project wins on scalars and plain lists; lists of objects with ids merge by id; [] clears a list).
merge_rules.subtract: The disabled list: entries {section?, id, reason} merge by (section, id), then each named entry is removed from its by-id section after the merge. A reason is required. section may be omitted when the id exists in exactly one by-id section.

field_rules.providers: For a default provider an overlay may not change kind, family or binary; forbidden_flags is add-only (the overlay's list is unioned onto the default's, [] is refused); forced_flags may only be appended to (the default flags stay as the prefix); sandbox_mode may only stay or tighten (read-only|strict < workspace-write < danger-full-access). No provider may force a layer-A bypass flag (--dangerously-*, --yolo*, --always-approve*, --full-auto*), danger-full-access, or one of its forbidden flags.
field_rules.tiers: For a default tier an overlay may not change model, effort or rank. Across all tiers, rank is monotonic with model strength (haiku < sonnet < opus = fable) and effort (low < medium < high < xhigh).
field_rules.roles: For a default role an overlay may not make a read-only role writable, grant a tool the default does not, or remove a disallowed tool. Roles a hard rule's review shape needs (reviewer; adversarial-reviewer for fanout6+adversarial) cannot be disabled.
field_rules.escalation: max_review_rounds <= 3 and the halt rung's at_failures <= 3; an overlay may only lower either.
